title: childhood-brain intake: one person
description: A person is a list of typed facts. A childhood is parents + school + life-changing events; city and decade are ordinary facts. Consented entries go in evals/data/consented/ (gitignored) after CONSENT.md is followed.

name.description: first name or chosen name; never a full legal name

bucket.description: demographic bucket used to pick self_recognition decoys, e.g. 1990s/north-america

consent.description: synthetic = generated; consented = a real participant per CONSENT.md, under evals/data/consented/; public = a public figure reconstructed from public sources, under evals/data/public/

x-fields.note: parent*/school/event* take seed slugs from evals/brains/prototype-data.ts; fragments are first-person memory lines; event slots may be 'none'.
